description:
超微今年不一樣了: four students from NCUE, Taiwan (Dun Jie Yang, Chang Sheng-Lin, Tseng Yun-Chen, Cheng-Hsun Liu).

Why "Keeling"? Charles David Keeling's CO2 record shows a seasonal cycle on top of a slow trend. Our tool looks past the season to find the trend. A tribute; his data is not used.

What it does: a web globe that asks four questions of NASA records: what is changing, where, how much, and is it significant? Every trend comes with its uncertainty.
